title: eQTL-source discordance in transcriptome-wide association studies: analysis code and processed data
description:
Analysis code, processed data and a containerized reproducibility environment for a methodological audit of eQTL weight-source dependence in transcriptome-wide association studies (TWAS).

With the GWAS input and the analytic pipeline held fixed, the study quantifies how the choice of eQTL weight source (GTEx v8 versus eQTLGen) changes TWAS gene candidacy; eQTL-source discordance denotes here the systematic perturbation of gene-candidacy conclusions (Z-score sign, candidate rank and FDR candidacy) induced by the weight source, when the GWAS input and pipeline are held fixed. It is an operational description and not a claim of causal confounding.

The audit decomposes that perturbation into a resource/sample-size axis and a tissue-context axis, calibrates it against disease-agnostic controls on a 104-gene testbed across three diabetic microvascular complications, and benchmarks it genome-wide on an independent trait. All headline Z-scores are recomputed with the unmodified official MetaXcan v0.8.1 binary after three-way allele harmonisation.

Scope. This record is a code and processed-data release. It carries the rendered figure build outputs of code/run_all.sh under figures/, so a reader can compare a re-run against what was shipped; figure captions, table legends and the submitted text files themselves accompany the manuscript and its Supporting Information and are not redistributed here. The producing scripts for all four main figures ship in code/figures/ge_main/ and regenerate each submitted PNG byte-identically. Of the four Supporting Information figures, Fig. S2 has a recovered producing script, Fig. S1 is reproducible at artefact level (the published raster plus the pixel patch that produced it ship in code/figures/ge_si/published/ and re-run to zero pixel difference; the base raster is from a different renderer build and is not script-level reproducible), and Fig. S4 is a silver-stain gel photograph for which no script can exist. Each figure's status is stated in figures/README.md. Raw RNA pull-down / LC-MS/MS spectra are deposited separately in the ProteomeXchange Consortium via iProX. External inputs that are not redistributed here are listed with identifiers, versions, retrieval dates and checksums in data/README.md.
